title: WorkPulse candidate.withdrawn v1
description: HR recorded that a candidate pulled out of the pipeline before being hired. Identifiers and the observed source stage only — withdrawal note text is PII and never leaves the database (`.ai/security.md`).

candidate_id.description: The withdrawn candidate application (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012 — candidate fallback).

job_id.description: The job the candidate applied to (UUIDv7 string).

withdrawn_from.description: Stage the candidate was in when the withdrawal was recorded.
